topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Well, I heard the landlord’s plans, and I must say, it’s about time our humble abode got a little shine. Condos, you say? Aye, it means a bit of change, but change ain’t always bad. Folks around here, they’ll have their own slice of the land, so to speak, like a plot of soil to call their own. I can see folks fixing up their places, putting their mark on it, making it fit just right. And maybe, just maybe, I might even get to plant a little garden of my own. It’s a good day, I reckon. The future’s looking brighter, and I’ve got a mind to start thinking about what I’ll grow come spring.
